body_paragraphs: I am writing on behalf of myself and Alex Example to claim compensation under UK Regulation 261/2004 (UK261) for the delay to flight EX 1234 from East Midlands to Marrakesh on 14 August 2026, booking reference ABC123.

The flight arrived at Marrakesh 4 hours and 20 minutes after its scheduled arrival time. The reason we were given at the airport was a technical problem with the aircraft. We were given one £5 voucher each and received no updates for the first three hours of the delay.

As the flight was between 1,500 and 3,500 km and we arrived more than three hours late, I am claiming £350 per passenger, £700 in total, as set out below. I am also claiming the cost of the meals we had to buy while we waited, for which I hold a receipt.
If you consider that the delay was caused by extraordinary circumstances, please provide evidence of those circumstances and of the reasonable measures you took to avoid the delay.
Please pay the amounts below within 14 days of the date of this letter and confirm your response in writing.
evidence_to_attach: If you have it: your booking confirmation showing both passengers
If you have it: boarding passes for flight EX 1234
If you have it: the receipt for the airport dinner
If you have it: any email or text from the airline about the delay
